meta.name: content-trend-researcher
meta.description: Advanced content and topic research skill that analyzes trends across Google Analytics, Google Trends, Substack, Medium, Reddit, LinkedIn, X, blogs, podcasts, and YouTube to generate data-driven article outlines based on user intent analysis

copy.tagline: 分析多平台趋势，生成数据驱动的文章大纲
copy.tagline_en: Analyze trends across platforms to generate data-driven article outlines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to mine hot topics from multiple platforms to plan content direction

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能分析 Google Trends、Reddit、YouTube 等 10 多个平台的热门话题，并生成数据驱动的文章大纲。
howto.when: 当你需要创作内容前，或想研究某个主题的趋势、用户意图时，可以要求它进行分析。

say.text: 帮我研究“AI自动化小企业”的趋势，看Google Trends和Reddit。
say.note: Claude 会分析这些平台并给出趋势报告。

say.text: 分析“远程办公工具”在YouTube和LinkedIn上的热门内容。
say.note: Claude 会返回平台洞察和内容建议。

say.text: 为“可持续时尚”生成一份包含博客大纲的多平台策略。
say.note: Claude 会输出平台特定想法和一篇长文大纲。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze trending topics across 10+ platforms like Google Trends, Reddit, and YouTube, and generate data-driven article outlines.
howto.when_en: Use this skill before creating content or when you need to research trends and user intent for a topic.

say_en.text: Research trends for 'AI automation for small businesses' on Google Trends and Reddit.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze these platforms and provide a trend report.

say_en.text: Analyze popular content about 'remote work tools' on YouTube and LinkedIn.
say_en.note: Claude will return platform insights and content suggestions.

say_en.text: Create a multi-platform strategy for 'sustainable fashion' including a blog outline.
say_en.note: Claude will output platform-specific ideas and a long-form outline.
